description: End-to-end scenario matrix for Agent Adda NSE workflows.

scenarios.title: Top-level CLI setup and historical bootstrap
assertions: setup --non-interactive writes config
data bootstrap --historical creates a market_data.sqlite database

scenarios.title: Data readiness planner and executor
assertions: readiness detects missing or stale datasets
PostgreSQL startup is attempted before loader execution
insufficient history exits cleanly instead of crashing

scenarios.title: Daily refresh orchestrator plan
assertions: refresh pipeline prints all planned stages
dry-run mode does not execute external fetch/load commands

scenarios.title: Terminal routing, symbol grounding, and response guardrails
assertions: market prompts route to the intended tools
requested symbols cannot be silently substituted
missing-evidence guardrails block unsupported conclusions
placeholder metrics are removed from rendered answers

scenarios.title: Intraday live snapshot, fallback, and PostgreSQL persistence
assertions: intraday analysis uses persisted OHLCV when available
missing OHLCV is surfaced as missing evidence
NSE live snapshot remains a snapshot and is not treated as candles

scenarios.title: Sector rotation tracker, breadth, and report generation
assertions: duplicate display sectors are deduplicated
missing SMA breadth is NO_DATA rather than false 0%
forced backfill cannot overwrite classified snapshots with all UNKNOWN stages

scenarios.title: Stage, momentum, turnaround, and terminal screener flows
assertions: stage screener classifies candidates from price history
terminal screener requests dispatch to deterministic screener tools

scenarios.title: PostgreSQL loader, screeners, F&O analytics, and views
assertions: EOD equities and indices are loaded
screeners run without missing schema/function errors
materialized views refresh successfully

scenarios.title: Enhanced PostgreSQL report run and HTML rendering
assertions: report run persists a new run_id
HTML rendering creates a non-trivial artifact
report tables have no orphan rows
slash-command parsing for /reports is stable

scenarios.title: Document/PDF analysis, company intelligence, and filings
assertions: wrapped PDF viewer URLs resolve to source PDFs
financial filing ingestion classifies and extracts evidence
company xray/index commands produce grounded outputs

scenarios.title: Strategy council and monitor scan terminal flows
assertions: strategy council routes multi-step prompts correctly
monitor scan commands return deterministic evidence-backed output

scenarios.title: Global market, macro proxy, and economic cycle flows
assertions: global market signals are generated with fallback-safe data
macro proxy cache/stale paths are handled explicitly
US/global prompts route to global intelligence flows

scenarios.title: Terminal report generation and latest-report lookup
assertions: preset reports generate expected artifacts
latest-report lookup finds the intended report family

scenarios.title: Knowledge base CLI contract
assertions: knowledge base CLI entry point starts and exposes subcommands

scenarios.title: Script and core module syntax smoke
assertions: major script entry points compile before E2E execution
